scripts.title: kill all fixed
scripts.features: kills all enemies when you press R
scripts.script:
local game = game
local players = game:GetService("Players")
local localPlayer = players.LocalPlayer
local character = nil
repeat wait(); character = workspace:FindFirstChild(localPlayer.Name) until character
local replicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local userInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")


userInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, chatting)
    if chatting then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.R then
        for _,v in workspace.NPCS:GetChildren() do
            if v:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and v.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                replicatedStorage.Eventos.DanoInimigoLocal:FireServer(1000000,v.Humanoid)
            end
        end
    end
end)

scripts.title: collect all the monies
scripts.features: collects all the monies that drop from enemies
scripts.script:
local game = game
local players = game:GetService("Players")
local localPlayer = players.LocalPlayer
local character = localPlayer.Character
local runService = game:GetService("RunService")

runService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(delta)
    character = localPlayer.Character
    for _,v in workspace.Moedas:GetChildren() do
        if v.Name == "Moeda" then
            firetouchinterest(v,character.HumanoidRootPart,0)
        end
    end
end)

            if v:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and v.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                replicatedStorage.Eventos.DanoInimigoLocal:FireServer(1000000,v.Humanoid)
            end
        end

end)
